description: Query a timeseries for a metric over a unix-timestamp window, returning a deterministic sine-shaped point series.

query.description: The metric query string; the seeded metric whose name appears in the query is matched.

from_.description: Start of the window as a unix timestamp (seconds).

to.description: End of the window as a unix timestamp (seconds); must be greater than from_.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the query result (query, from_date, to_date, series); on failure (invalid timestamps), output contains an error message.

description: List monitors, optionally filtered by overall_state.

overall_state.description: Optional overall_state to filter monitors by (e.g. OK, Warn, Alert).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of monitor objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single monitor by its id.

monitor_id.description: The unique id of the monitor.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the monitor object; on failure (monitor not found), output contains an error message.

message.description: Optional notification message for the monitor.

tags.description: Optional list of tags for the monitor.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created monitor object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing monitor by its id.

monitor_id.description: The unique id of the monitor to update.

name.description: Optional new name for the monitor.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated monitor object; on failure (monitor not found), output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'dashboards' list; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single dashboard by its id.

dashboard_id.description: The unique id of the dashboard.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the dashboard object; on failure (dashboard not found), output contains an error message.

description: List events, optionally filtered by a start/end unix-timestamp window, sorted most-recent first.

start.description: Optional start unix timestamp; only events with date_happened >= start are returned.

end.description: Optional end unix timestamp; only events with date_happened <= end are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with an 'events' list; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Create a new event in the event stream.

alert_type.description: Optional alert type (default 'info'; e.g. info, error, warning, success).

host.description: Optional host associated with the event.

tags.description: Optional list of tags for the event.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with status and the created event; on failure, output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'host_list' and 'total_returned'; on failure, output contains an error message.
